description: This file defines the SubSupervisor class, an Akka actor responsible for supervising subscription-related actors in a pub/sub system. It manages child actors for handling subscriptions, acknowledgements, and data replication, and includes methods for creating Props and handling lifecycle events.

classes.name: SubSupervisor
classes.description: An Akka actor supervising subscription actors, managing their lifecycle, and handling data consistency in a distributed pub/sub system. Generic over message type T and topic type U.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates a Props object for the SubSupervisor actor with specified message class, topic extractor, and data access objects.

methods.name: createPubSubBehavior
methods.description: Defines the actor's message handling behavior, setting up pattern matching for subscription management and termination handling.

methods.name: startChildren
methods.description: Initializes child actors for subscribers, updater, and acknowledgements updater, and sets up watchers.

methods.name: subscriberTerminated
methods.description: Handles termination of subscriber actors, removing them from distributed data.

methods.name: onChildFailure
methods.description: Handles failure of child actors, resetting updater state and logging errors.

methods.name: isUpdaterAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the updater actor reference is available.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Forwards subscription requests to the updater actor.

methods.name: isAcksUpdaterAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the acknowledgements updater actor is available.

methods.name: declareAckLabels
methods.description: Sends a message to start subscribing to acknowledgement labels.

methods.name: updaterUnavailable
methods.description: Handles scenarios where the updater actor is unavailable, signaling an exception to the sender.

methods.name: acksUpdaterUnavailable
methods.description: Handles scenarios where the acknowledgements updater actor is unavailable, signaling an exception to the sender.

methods.name: removeAcknowledgementLabelDeclaration
methods.description: Removes acknowledgement label subscriptions when a subscriber terminates.
